summary: First-finish smoke test for Market Masters. Backend auth, round state controls, R1/R2 submissions (incl. duplicate + state guards), R3 session idempotency, trade validation (contradictory + sign checks), 2-trade cap, admin verify (REJECTED-without-reason=400), leaderboard, scores/me, analytics, audit-logs, all 5 CSV exports, event config PUT, and RBAC (team=>403, unauth=>401) all pass. Frontend: landing->register->dashboard redirect works; team dashboard shows all 3 round tiles; admin login lands on /admin with all 6 tabs, stats cards, and round state controls rendered. One minor bug: POST /api/announcements returns 500 (ObjectId serialization) though the row IS inserted (visible in GET).
passed: POST /api/auth/login (admin) and POST /api/auth/register-team (fresh team) return JWT token
GET /api/questions?round=1 returns 20 questions and does NOT expose correct_answer
POST /api/rounds/1/submit works; duplicate submission=>400 'Already submitted'; blocked when PAUSED (400 'not active')
POST /api/rounds/3/start returns same session on 2nd call (idempotent, timer non-resettable)

POST /api/rounds/3/trades: contradictory PROFIT (loss>0) rejected 400; negative pl_percentage on PROFIT rejected 400; valid PROFIT and LOSS trades accepted; 3rd trade rejected 400 'Trade limit reached'
POST /api/admin/trades/{id}/verify: REJECTED without reason=>400 'Reason required'; VERIFIED succeeds; team call=>403
GET /api/scores/me returns the team's own row
GET /api/admin/analytics returns totals (teams, submissions, trades, pending/verified/rejected, avg/best)
Frontend: /dashboard shows dashboard-round-1/2/3 tiles with -enter buttons, rank/total/risk testids present
Frontend: admin login navigates to /admin, all admin-tab-{control,verify,teams,config,audit,export} and admin-r{1,2,3}-{UPCOMING,ACTIVE,PAUSED,COMPLETED} controls render

failed.issue: POST /api/announcements returns 500 Internal Server Error even though the document IS inserted (GET /api/announcements returns it). Likely cause: motor insert_one mutates the dict to inject a non-serializable ObjectId `_id`, and the handler returns `doc` without doing `doc.pop('_id', None)` (as is correctly done in list_announcements and audit_logs).
failed.evidence: server.py:790-795 create_announcement returns `doc` directly after insert_one; curl POST /api/announcements with admin token -> HTTP 500 'Internal Server Error'; subsequent GET /api/announcements returns the newly created row.

action_items: In /app/backend/server.py create_announcement (around line 793), add `doc.pop('_id', None)` after `await db.announcements.insert_one(doc)` so the POST response serializes correctly (fixes 500 on admin broadcast from UI).
No frontend-blocking issues; otherwise ready for full QA pass.
